payload.title: Engineer and test individual decision features before classifier promotion
payload.description: Agreed plan (2026-10-05): separate feature admission from fitted-classifier promotion. Current three-control scheduler bundles supporting questions; a losing bundle does not disprove individual concepts. Implement in order: (1) persistent individual feature bank with stable identity, wording revisions, intended concept, options, training evidence references, rationale, lineage, coverage and trial history; proposed/measured/deferred/deployed states, no permanent deletion on failure; (2) descriptive class-conditional probability/missingness diagnostics with counts, not held-out performance claims; (3) one-question additions against one frozen incumbent rubric/example list/model/partitions/weighting/fit, cached full requests and explicit budgets; (4) bounded pairs/groups and leave-one-question-out ablations for incremental value, redundancy and interactions; (5) wording refinement using training feedback only and fair retry as evidence grows; (6) reusable lifecycle events and Rich inspection of feature bank, trial diffs, actual optimizer exchanges, Jev requests, fits and deployment. Keep measured Brier promotion gate: any strict improvement currently qualifies, so do not merely lower a nonexistent large threshold. Development/audit labels must never enter optimizer briefing or demonstrations; sealed scoreboard must not steer search. Specs first with fake clients for isolation, deterministic budgets, revisions/retries, restart safety and failed-trial incumbent preservation. First milestone: auditable single-feature addition through decision answers, numerical fit and visible development result. Combination experiments follow after verification. Evaluations go in the separate evaluations repository; no DSPy, retrieval or input filtering. This is planned work, not implemented capability.
